//go:build integration

package student

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestHybridSnapshotActualRegisteredStudentOwner(t *testing.T) {
	file := os.Getenv("T201_OWNER_READY_FILE")
	if file == "" {
		t.Skip("root owner proof gate unset")
	}
	var ready struct {
		URL       string                   `json:"url"`
		StudentID string                   `json:"student_id"`
		PathID    string                   `json:"path_id"`
		Targets   []domain.HybridTargetRef `json:"targets"`
		Token     string                   `json:"token"`
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(file)
	if err != nil || json.Unmarshal(raw, &ready) != nil {
		t.Fatal("owner provider ready file required")
	}
	c := Client{BaseURL: ready.URL, WriteToken: ready.Token, HTTPClient: &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}}
	s, err := c.GetHybridPlanningSnapshot(context.Background(), ready.StudentID, ready.PathID, domain.HybridSnapshotRequest{Targets: ready.Targets, TriggerContext: domain.HybridSnapshotTrigger{Kind: "root-owner-proof", Reason: "T20.1 registered Student HTTP PG consumer compatibility"}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("actual owner consumer rejected coherent snapshot: %v", err)
	}
	qualities := map[domain.HybridEvidenceQuality]bool{}
	for _, e := range s.Evidence {
		qualities[domain.ClassifyHybridEvidence(e)] = true
	}
	for _, q := range []domain.HybridEvidenceQuality{domain.HybridQualityAssessment, domain.HybridQualityExecution, domain.HybridQualityProject} {
		if !qualities[q] {
			t.Fatalf("actual owner quality absent: %s", q)
		}
	}
	if s.Path.Version < 1 || s.References.SnapshotRef == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing authoritative applicability")
	}
	t.Log("registered Student HTTP/PG → real Planner strict client/classifier passed; named owner metadata fixtures, no evidence-ingress claim")
}
